description:
Hello
We have an Immediate opening for Oracle Database Developer position in Durham (RTP), NC, please go thru the job description below and revert me back ASAP, If Interested.
 
Position: Oracle Database Developer
Location: Durham (RTP), NC
Type: 12+ Months 

 Job Description: 
*** Client Prefers consultants local to NC, SC, VA, MD, DC, PA, NY or NJ ***
*** Client prefers In-Person Interview after Phone Screen ***

 Job Description 
• 9+ Years’ experience working as Oracle Database Developer is required.
• Experience with GMP and Data Integrity and Database Auditing experience is MUST.
• Experience with integration of Oracle with 3rd party systems using an integration layer is REQUIRED.
• Strong background with Oracle Fusion Middleware a MUST.
•
 Develops, produces, and maintains structural design of custom 
databases for housing supplier data, based upon logical data models by 
employing program and business requirements and analysis.
• Ability to work cross-functionally with middleware and LIMS teams to integrate the database.
• Applicable experience working on custom database development.
